The '''Bethal system''' contained [[Bethal]]. It was in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Pelagia Province]], between the [[Kamper system/Legends|Kamper]] and [[Pelagon system/Legends|Pelagon systems]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
